takeaway: Citizens register, log in, report problems and follow them; municipal operators review received reports, update status, add notes and monitor trends.

elements.name: Citizen
elements.responsibility: Role: files and follows reports; dashboard shows create/submitted buttons only

elements.name: Municipal operator
elements.responsibility: Role: handles received reports, status, notes, trends

elements.name: Register and log in
elements.responsibility: Sign up as citizen or municipal operator, authenticate; dashboard adapts to role

elements.name: Report a problem
elements.responsibility: Citizen submits a categorised, located report

elements.name: Track my reports and notifications
elements.responsibility: Citizen lists submitted reports, sees history and status notifications

elements.name: Review received reports
elements.responsibility: Operator lists, filters and opens received reports

elements.name: Update status or add internal note
elements.responsibility: Operator changes a report's status (citizen is notified) or records an internal note
